title: Recover a resource deficit
trade_off: Extra resource jobs and districts cost upkeep and may draw workers away from other production.
change_course_if: The next autosave shows a non-negative monthly balance, or open jobs cannot be filled.

title: Stabilize an existing colony
trade_off: A corrective building or job change has an upkeep and opportunity cost; inspect the colony before building.
change_course_if: Stability and amenities recover, or the colony screen shows a different cause of unrest.

title: Restore Trade balance before expanding

sources.ref: Steam Guide 3829341385 (RedEye, 29 Oct 2026): 4.5 Trade upkeep and local colony deficit fees

trade_off: Adding Trade or Logistics jobs occupies pops that could produce alloys or research; Market buys incur a 30% base fee.
change_course_if: Monthly Trade turns positive or local colony resource deficits are eliminated.

title: Fix industrial mineral deficit
trade_off: Pausing construction or shifting metallurgists slows fleet growth but protects stockpiles and avoids shortage penalties.
change_course_if: Mineral monthly balance stabilizes and mining jobs are staffed.

title: Coordinate Nomads Arkships, Waystations, and escorts

sources.ref: Stellaris 4.5.2 Cygnus notes: Arkship and Waystation preference policies
Nomads DLC Arkship fleet limits and Wayline defense guidance

trade_off: Tier III Military Arkships are limited to one per fleet and Waystations need protection or cloaking along exposed Waylines.
change_course_if: Waylines are disrupted by hostiles or Operational Reserves cannot sustain further fleet expansion.

title: Plan Apocalypse capital hulls and fleet auras

sources.ref: Apocalypse Titan Perdition Beam and fleet aura guidance (verify in Ship Designer)

base_game_alternative: Without Apocalypse, pair Cruiser/Battleship artillery cores with Flak/PD Destroyer screens.
trade_off: Capital ships and Titans require large alloy investments, naval capacity, and escort screening against swarms.
change_course_if: Alloy income turns negative, naval capacity is exceeded, or enemy fleets shift to high-evasion swarms.
